name: Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport
positioning: Seaport District hotel near downtown Boston with harbor and skyline views and a year-round heated rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want a Seaport District base with Boston Harbor views
Visitors attending events at the Thomas Michael Menino Convention and Exhibition Center
Guests who want a full-service spa and a well-equipped fitness center

facts.text: The hotel is in the Seaport District near downtown Boston, with unobstructed Boston Harbor waterfront views.
The hotel is near South Station, the harbor and the Thomas Michael Menino Convention and Exhibition Center.
The hotel is 2.8 miles, about 8 minutes, from Boston Logan International Airport.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city and harbor views.
Artist Tower rooms are cozy studio-layout rooms designed for the individual traveler.
Breve Spa is the hotel's full-service spa, offering full body treatments, a sauna and a steam room.
The fitness center has 200 feet of continuous floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light.
Artist Tower guests can borrow fitness gear for free through a partnership with Boston-born apparel company NOBULL.
The hotel offers rooftop fitness classes.
The hotel has an all-day restaurant serving Mediterranean fare.
The hotel welcomes medium-size dogs and cats.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel as a Readers' Choice Awards winner for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026.

highlights.text: A heated rooftop pool and hot tub on the fifth floor are both open year-round, with views of the city skyline.
The suites have floor-to-ceiling windows looking out on Massachusetts Bay and the Seaport skyline.
Patron Tower rooms have a spacious floor plan with sweeping harbor or Seaport District views.
A rooftop pool bar and grill looks out over the skyline and the water.

considerations.text: Pool availability depends on capacity limits, and the pool deck can close for private events.
Guests must be at least 21 years old to check in.
Self and valet parking carry a nightly charge.
